title: Admin login with valid credentials and 2FA
description: Verify that an Admin user can log in successfully using valid username/password and two-factor authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input valid admin username and password
Submit login form
Enter valid 2FA code
Verify login is successful and Admin dashboard is displayed with JWT token issued

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login is denied with incorrect username or password for all role types.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input invalid username or password
Submit login form
Verify login error message is displayed and access denied

title: Password reset workflow for a user
description: Verify the password reset works correctly with valid email and token, including email notification of reset link.

steps.description: Navigate to password reset page
Enter registered email address
Request password reset link
Verify reset email is received
Use reset link to open password reset form
Input new valid password and confirm
Verify password is updated and user can login with new credentials

title: Create, Read, Update and Delete (CRUD) for Vendor entity by Admin
description: Verify Admin can perform full CRUD operations on vendor profiles including validation of data integrity.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Create a new vendor with valid profile data
Verify vendor is created and appears in vendor list
Read vendor profile details
Verify vendor details match input data
Update vendor profile with valid changes
Verify updates are saved and reflected
Delete the vendor
Verify vendor is removed from the system

title: Supplier subscription payment processing via Stripe
description: Verify that Supplier user can successfully subscribe using Stripe integration and subscription status updates accordingly.

steps.description: Login as Supplier
Select a subscription plan and proceed to payment
Enter valid payment information through Stripe gateway
Verify payment is processed successfully and subscription status is active
Access subscription and payment history page
Verify recent subscription payment is logged correctly

title: Role-based authorization prevents unauthorized access
description: Verify users cannot access endpoints or UI features outside their authorized roles using JWT tokens and access control.

steps.description: Login as Vendor user
Attempt to access Admin-specific endpoints and features
Verify access is denied and appropriate error is returned
Login as Supplier user and try to modify other vendor's inventory
Verify forbidden error is returned

title: Inventory management CRUD operations with stock level tracking
description: Verify Vendors and Suppliers can perform CRUD on inventory items and stock levels update correctly with validations.

steps.description: Login as Vendor
Create a new inventory item with valid stock levels
Verify item appears in inventory list with correct stock
Update stock levels for existing inventory item
Verify stock levels are updated in real-time
Delete an inventory item
Verify item is removed and stock levels reflect deletion

title: Order creation and tracking by Vendor
description: Verify Vendor users can create purchase orders to Suppliers, track order status, and view comprehensive order history.

steps.description: Login as Vendor
Create a purchase order selecting supplier and inventory items
Verify new order is successfully created with correct details
Track order status through different stages (submitted, approved, fulfilled)
Verify order status changes are updated in real-time
Access order history page
Verify all past orders are displayed accurately

title: Machine learning forecasting response and accuracy
description: Verify that ML forecasting endpoints return predictions within 2 seconds and the forecast data meets precision criteria.

steps.description: Request demand forecast for a given vendor and time range
Verify response time is under 2 seconds
Verify forecast results meet expected accuracy and precision metrics
Request inventory and cost forecasts
Verify results correctness and performance benchmarks

title: Email and system notification delivery with user preferences
description: Verify that notifications are sent via email and in-app system alerts according to user-configured preferences.

steps.description: Login as any user
Configure notification preferences to enable/disable email and/or system notifications
Trigger system event that generates notifications (e.g. order status change)
Verify notifications are delivered only via enabled channels
Verify notifications contain correct content and links

title: File upload and processing with AWS S3 integration
description: Verify that users can successfully upload files, files are stored in AWS S3, and processed files update system accordingly.

steps.description: Login as Vendor or Supplier
Upload a valid file (e.g. product catalog CSV)
Verify upload completes without errors
Verify uploaded file is successfully stored in AWS S3 bucket
Verify file processing job completes and data is reflected in system (e.g. new products created)

title: Multi-tenant data isolation enforcement
description: Verify that data is isolated per tenant and users cannot access or manipulate data belonging to other tenants.

steps.description: Login as user of tenant A
Attempt to access vendor, supplier or inventory data belonging to tenant B
Verify access is denied with proper authorization error
Try to create or update resources with tenant B identifiers
Verify system rejects unauthorized operations

title: Subscription plan changes and payment renewal workflow
description: Verify that suppliers can change subscription plans, payments are processed correctly and subscription status updates without issues.

steps.description: Login as Supplier user with an active subscription
Request to upgrade or downgrade subscription plan
Complete any required payment through Stripe
Verify subscription details and billing history are updated accordingly

title: Custom report generation with role-based data filtering
description: Verify users can generate custom reports according to role limits and reports contain correct filtered data.

steps.description: Login as Vendor
Request generation of a custom report with specific parameters
Verify report is generated with correct data matching parameters
Attempt to generate reports accessing data outside role's scope
Verify access to unauthorized data is prevented

title: System maintains 99.9% uptime under load
description: Verify that the platform maintains 99.9% uptime during operational hours and responsive under expected load conditions.

steps.description: Simulate concurrent users performing key operations (login, CRUD, payments)
Verify system remains responsive with less than predefined latency benchmarks
Check system uptime and availability logs over a defined period
Confirm uptime percentage meets or exceeds 99.9%

title: Security compliance: HTTPS enforcement, JWT validation, and data encryption
description: Verify platform enforces HTTPS, validates JWT tokens correctly, and encrypts sensitive data in transit and at rest.

steps.description: Access platform endpoints via HTTP
Verify redirection to HTTPS occurs
Send requests with invalid or expired JWT tokens
Verify requests are rejected with appropriate error codes
Inspect data storage and verify encryption of sensitive fields
Confirm encryption standards are met for data at rest

title: User profile management with role updates
description: Verify users across all roles can update their profiles and Admin can update user roles with validation.

steps.description: Login as Vendor user
Update profile information (contact, address, preferences)
Verify changes are saved and reflected in profile
Login as Admin
Change roles of other users
Verify role changes are applied and proper access rights are granted or revoked
